scientific_integrity: The universal claim follows from explicit finite-space probability identities and a self-contained RKHS proof. The numerical verifier checks only small exact instances. The work has not undergone independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite counting-measure domain; symmetric positive-definite one-spike diagonal kernel; exact pivoting, determinants, and optimal quadrature weights; fixed m,k as L diverges; expected squared worst-case RKHS errors only; no continuous-domain or unsquared-error guarantee.
title: Sharp target-dependent crossover and unbounded quadrature error gap between pivoted Cholesky and volume sampling
